title: Permutation invariance of product inner product
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$. For any permutation $\sigma$ of the $n$ coordinates and any functions $f,g:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$, their product inner product under the independent product distribution with marginal $\pi$ is unchanged when both functions are composed with the same coordinate permutation.
